HexKagune 1.0.27 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 43). Testing build.

- **Stutter fix (likely cause):** every expansion animation (Ayato's wings and kakuja, tendrils, centipede, masks, War and Peace) ran on the world's game time, which the server resets once a second and sets back several ticks when it lags. They now run on a smooth client clock that eases onto the server's time and never jumps. The original mod's own kagune still use game time.
- **War RMB, the spike cone:** swipe your free hand where you look and thin, sharp spikes shoot out of the ground in rows, narrow at your hand and about 10 blocks wide 13 blocks out. Each row sits on the ground where it lands, so the cone climbs steps and ledges and skips drops and walls. Hits bleed and slow.
- **King's Execution at nothing:** dash where you look, throw both hands up, and three rings of spikes burst up around you out to 5 blocks, slowing and bleeding.
- **King's Execution at a target (7 blocks):** a blink-dash in, then you flash in and out of view leaving afterimages. Punch, blade cut (bleed), rising kick, then a slowed wind-up and a gut punch that drives them into the floor. The impact leaves a 4.5-block crater with cracks splitting out, hits everyone in it, and shakes the screen of everyone within 25 blocks. They ragdoll after.
- **Black Sun (ultimate, 5 blocks):** dash in and uppercut them 14 blocks into the sky, leap up beside them, cock back and unleash the punch. A ring of smoke and snow tears out across 45 blocks and the ground shakes for 40. They crash down at a steep angle through anything in the way (never into the ground) and skid along it to a stop. Every block broken grows back afterwards.
- **Your view locks onto the target** through the blitz and Black Sun, wherever the blinks put you. You can't be hit during them, and their falls don't hurt.
- **New poses** for the swipe, the raised hands, every beat of the blitz and every beat of Black Sun. In the air your legs are part of the move.
